dashboard: To drive on the layout you need to add a vehicle in the "Vehicles" tab with a DCC address, then click <addIcon></addIcon> to add (accept) it to the current layout. Once the vehicle is added, choose <throttleIcon></throttleIcon> at the top of the screen
myVehicles: To drive a vehicle on the layout you must add (accept) it to the current layout with the <addIcon></addIcon> icon. Right after adding, the vehicle may have no functions assigned — to assign them use <functionsIcon></functionsIcon>, where you can set them manually or copy from another vehicle or a ready-made template.
rentals: You can temporarily rent a vehicle to someone else, or someone else can rent their vehicle to you. When another person takes control of a vehicle, the previous person temporarily loses it — though the owner can always reclaim that control. Changing who is driving a vehicle stops it.
myTrains: Combine several vehicles into one train so you can control multiple locomotives at once and turn on coach lights in a single control view. Note — global limits on the number of controlled vehicles and occupied LocoNet slots set by the layout administrator apply
